- In the year one thousand nine hundred, darkness fell upon the world.
- Behold, the heavens split with the roar of war.
- And lo, two great wars came, and nations wept.
- The sands of time became ash with fire.
- From the dust of cities rose machines of terror.
- They split the atom, but the very earth trembled.
- A pestilence swept the land, and millions perished in silence.
- The earth was split, and the wall between east and west endured for long.
- And in the final decades, a great light dawned.
- The voice of man reached beyond the stars.
- Ho, people of the age, remember that which endured, and what is.
- O, woe is the generation that saw both fury and hope in one brief span.
